items.title: Financial statements for 2025
decisions: that the financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, with the directors' and auditors' reports, be received

items.title: Dividend
decisions: that a final dividend of €0.40 per ordinary share be declared, payable on 30 June 2026

items.title: Auditors
decisions: that the directors be authorised to fix the remuneration of the auditors
